records.requirement: Approved combinations of regional social role, occupation, legal status and mobility for river users compatible with the selected G4.
Approved age/demographic options without asserted ethnic percentages.
Source-backed or explicitly approved regional name pool for the valid period.
Weighted name forms linked to the approved pool; no runtime invention.
Visible appearance options expressed through approved regional categories.
Garment slots and constraints compatible with role, work, season and wet river environment.
Role/occupation-specific equipment profile for landing and river work.
Approved item templates or categories with required/optional flags and weights.
Knowledge of local water, shoals, wind, landing access, rights and route uncertainty with source references.
Approved behavior option and bounded decision policy; no free behavioral payload.
Causally grounded landing/river activity tied to the selected G4 or its parent place.
Time-band schedule and movement/fallback activity compatible with late-summer open water.
Approved household, work-group, dependency, stranger and authority relations applicable to local river users.
Complete background and scene profile sets referencing the approved component records. Key level is created only when party consequences require it.
G4-specific slot, counts, presence reason, causal basis, applicability, period, confidence, weight and approved status.

acceptance_criteria: all foreign keys resolve in the same pinned world revision
every required candidate set is non-empty after period/region/season/applicability filtering
the selected G4 has an unambiguous approved profile-set binding
the rule records a causal presence reason and materialization trace inputs
no component is supplied by fallback or LLM repair
